text:
lee (Hiring Manager): Heads up  new PM hire (Asha) starts Monday AM. Need a 1-page first-week agenda + short 30/60/90 bullets I can paste into a welcome email. Also a tiny "who to ping" list for access issues.
marie (People Ops): Can do. Ill keep it paste-friendly. Any device delivery preference?
kai (IT): Default ship to SF office. Will add to groups: eng-read, product, docs-edit. Need full name + shipping address via DM. Imaging scheduled Mon 07:00 PT.
lee (Hiring Manager): SF office desk ok. DMing details now. Include product and analytics view-only.
nina (Security): Note: 2FA required before infra creds. Ill run a 10-min security intro Tue 3pm. KMS access needs ticket and manager approval.
onboard-bot: New-hire packet created for asha.p. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO enrollment. Due: 2026-04-05 17:00 PT.
marie (People Ops): Pasteable first-week agenda:
- Day 0 (prestart): confirm device, complete HR forms, Slack + SSO invite.
- Day 1: 9:30 People Ops welcome (benefits/expectations), 11:00 manager 1:1, 2:30 buddy intro, 4:30 team standup.
- Day 2: 10:00 product overview, 1:00 analytics demo, 3:00 small starter task assigned.
- Day 3: docs walkthrough, pair on first ticket, security intro (10m).
- Day 4-5: finish starter task, meet cross-functional partners, EOW 30-min check-in with manager.
EOW deliverable: open a small docs PR + short "top 3 takeaways" note.
marie (People Ops): Short 30/60/90 bullets for manager email:
- 30d: complete orientation, ship initial starter task, join weekly product sync.
- 60d: own a small roadmap slice, run cross-team sync, own metrics for feature area.
- 90d: lead delivery of a minor feature, reduce cycle time for own tasks, propose one process improvement.
marie (People Ops): Who to ping (copyable): IT (device/account) - @kai; Security (creds/2FA) - @nina; People Ops (payroll/benefits) - @marie; Buddy/Team - manager assigns.
lee (Hiring Manager): Perfect. Please slot a 20-min "expectations" touch on Friday 3:30 for me.
marie (People Ops): Added Fri 3:30. Ill DM the one-pager and attach to Asha's profile. :rocket:
